The Prophet went to reconcile quarrelling people, a verse orders peace between fighting believers, a peacemaker saying good things is no liar, and spouses may reconcile on terms.
Al-Hasan bin Ali made peace with Muawiya on guaranteed terms, as the Prophet had said Allah may make peace between two great Muslim groups through this son of his.
As Al-Hasan bin Ali moved with armies against Muawiya, peace was proposed, and the Prophet had called Al-Hasan a chief through whom Allah may make peace between two Muslim groups.
